title: MMIO Status Snapshot
shortDescription: Decode a volatile status register and acknowledge write-one-to-clear flags.

objectives: Decode a volatile status register and acknowledge write-one-to-clear flags

hints.nudge: Does reading a hardware register twice necessarily give the same value?
hints.approach: Use one status snapshot for decoding. Treat write-one-to-clear acknowledgements separately from ordinary read-modify-write updates; acknowledge only the requested flags.

templates.notes: Read the status register once, decode fields, then write the clear mask.

visibleCases.name: all clear
visibleCases.displayExpect:
rc = 0
out.ready = false
out.fault = false
out.overrun = false
out.mode = 0
out.error_code = 0
clear = 0x00000000
visibleCases.explanation: Zero status should decode to defaults.

visibleCases.name: decode fields
visibleCases.displayExpect:
rc = 0
out.ready = true
out.fault = true
out.overrun = false
out.mode = 5
out.error_code = 42  // 0x2A
clear = 0x00000002
visibleCases.explanation: Masks and shifts extract each register field.

visibleCases.name: acknowledge clearable flags
visibleCases.displayExpect:
rc = 0
out.ready = false
out.fault = true
out.overrun = true
out.mode = 7
out.error_code = 17  // 0x11
clear = 0x00000006
visibleCases.explanation: Only clearable bits should be acknowledged.

hiddenCases.name: reserved bits ignored
hiddenCases.explanation: Unknown bits should not leak into output.

hiddenCases.name: ready is not clearable
hiddenCases.explanation: Do not write non-W1C bits to the clear register.
